draft_note: UNRATIFIED DRAFT (tempdoc 755 Track 2 / charter §C). This file is NOT loaded by any code path: `utility_claim_policy.policy_path()` hardcodes `utility-claim-policy.v1.json` and the publication pointer points at v1, so this `.proposed` sibling is inert by construction. It exists because Track 1 (capture hardening: get_mcp_status retry + integrity-checked fallback) may leave a residual, measured, irreducible `get_mcp_status()` miss rate (~8%/cell historically; 4-12 unverified B-cells per 60-cell stratum in the 2026-07-18 confirmatory campaign, tempdocs 675/725) that makes the ratified all-cells-verified `verified_tool_surface` gate structurally unsatisfiable (P(all ~240 B-cells verified) ~ 0). The amendment below replaces all-cells-verified with a rate + consistency rule that still treats a DIFFERENT observed hash as fatal (only a MISSING hash is downgraded to a capture miss). Activating this — or any amendment to the ratified policy — requires the founder's explicit word (charter §D founder gate); do NOT promote to `status: active`, rename to `utility-claim-policy.v1.json`, or repoint the publication pointer without it.

verified_tool_surface_semantics.supersedes_rule: every attempted with-tool cell must carry observed_mcp_tool_surface_hash == declared hash (all-cells-verified)
verified_tool_surface_semantics.new_rule: verified_tool_surface passes iff ALL of: (a) surface verification rate >= minimum_surface_verification_rate (0.9), where a verified cell is a with-tool attempted cell carrying an observed hash obtained from status/status-retry evidence; (b) observed_mcp_tool_surface_consistent == true; (c) exactly one distinct observed hash across the arm and it equals the cohort's declared mcp_tool_surface_hash; (d) zero cells carry a DIFFERENT observed hash.
verified_tool_surface_semantics.missing_hash: a with-tool cell with no observed hash after Track-1 retry + fallback is a CAPTURE MISS, not a violation — it lowers the verification rate (bounded by 1 - 0.9 = 10%) but does not fail the gate on its own.
verified_tool_surface_semantics.different_hash: a with-tool cell whose observed hash DIFFERS from the declared hash stays FATAL — this is a genuine surface mismatch, never a capture miss, and any single occurrence fails the gate regardless of rate.
verified_tool_surface_semantics.evidence: residual measured flake after Track 1 is the trigger; if Track 1's smoke campaign reports 100% verified B-cells the residual is zero and this amendment is unnecessary. See tempdoc 755 §A/§B and the 2026-07-18 confirmatory VERDICT record.
verified_tool_surface_semantics.activation_note: Encoding these semantics as executable gate logic (utility_claim_policy.py:394-406) is part of RATIFICATION, not this draft — Track 1 deliberately leaves that gate code untouched.
